allOf.title: CloudEvents 1.0 envelope (structured mode, ADR 0021)
allOf.description: The ONLY envelope on every topic this service produces or consumes. Every attribute is REQUIRED in this fleet. Kafka header `content-type: application/cloudevents+json; charset=UTF-8`. W3C trace context travels in the `traceparent`/`tracestate` Kafka headers, never as extension attributes.

id.description: Minted once per domain event and persisted with the outbox row, so a relay redelivery carries the same id. The consumer's de-duplication key.

source.description: `/warehouse/<repo>` of the publisher — `/warehouse/labor-performance` for everything this service publishes, `/warehouse/fulfillment-execution` for TaskCompleted.

type.description: `com.warehouse.<subdomain>.<bounded-context>.<entity>.<EventName>`. Consumers dispatch on the FULL string.

subject.description: Id of the aggregate instance the event is about. Never empty.

time.description: The domain event's occurred-at instant, UTC (RFC 3339).

task_id.description: fulfillment-execution's task id, treated as an opaque foreign reference. This context does not own or validate it.

associate_id.description: The associate who completed the task, and the partition key of this topic. The EMPTY STRING is a legitimate, expected value: the completing station had no checked-in occupant (e.g. a robot station).

task_type.description: PICK, PACK, SLAM, or the empty string when the task type could not be resolved (see the analytics payload's identical field for why this is common today).

efficiency_pct.description: 100 * standard_seconds_at_completion / actual_seconds, or NULL when the task could not be scored. NULL is a real business fact ("unmeasurable"); a consumer MUST NOT coerce it to 0.

idle_seconds_before.description: The measured idle gap immediately preceding this task's claim, added by the idleness feature (ADR 0014-labor-utilization-idleness). NULL — never a fabricated number — when there was no prior completion, the gap was negative/zero (out-of-order Kafka delivery), or the completing station had no checked-in occupant. ADDITIVE field: a Conformist unmarshaling unknown-field- tolerant JSON (e.g. workforce-management's laborperformancecache) is unaffected by its presence.

completed_at.description: When the associate actually finished the task — the BUSINESS time, distinct from the CloudEvents `time` attribute.
